resource: Declared Channel required_gameplay_capabilities before dependency closure
unit: declared capability ids per Channel scope
allocation_impact: The node configuration list is bounded and checked sorted, unique and registered before the dependency closure is built; boot then refuses the generation (no readiness) when a declared ID or the mandatory floor is unoffered. The closure stays bounded by the protocol capability count (128) and the existing negotiated-selection capacity; no larger set is allocated.
notes: ADMIT0 §3.1. The configured value is the operator's declared list, not a tunable cap: 0..16 IDs. The bound applies to the declaration only; the mandatory floor and registry requires are added by the closure afterwards and are bounded separately.
